rules.title: RSO Annual Allowable Rent Increase
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) are limited to 3% for the period July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.quoted_span: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective

rules.title: RSO Utilities Increase Elimination
rules.requirement: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord of an RSO unit can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities on top of the annual allowable rent increase.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.quoted_span: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.

rules.title: Rent Increase Notice Requirement
rules.requirement: State law requires landlords to provide 30 days' written advance notice of rent increases of less than 10%.
rules.key_value: 30 days' written advance notice for increases of less than 10%
rules.coverage_text: Landlords raising rent by less than 10%.
rules.quoted_span: State law requires landlords to provide 30 days' written advance notice of rent increases of less than 10%.
